name: Spined Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the spined devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The spined devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Fork Tail attacks.

actions.name: Fork Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spine Volley
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 20/80 ft., up to three targets. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

description: Spined devils are winged, gargoyle-like fiends who serve as messengers and airborne skirmishers, raining barbed tail spines on their foes from above.
